# ADR-004: Generate Python representation conversions

Status: chosen_for_two_rules

Concerns: Q-interfaces, Q-reproduce

## Decision

Use recorded AST rules for the original GetBoxCenter tuple result and Boolean-to-integer isCloaked input conversion.

## Rationale

Original tuple construction and unchanged original fixture expectations define the boundary. The rules preserve the existing dispatch path and surrounding code.

## Alternatives

Handwrite per-feature wrappers; alter original test assertions.

## Consequences

The three affected original cases pass natively. Full uint8 cloak-domain, raw attribute side effects and notification semantics remain unresolved.
